event_name: Document 65 Date 12 September 2021 Time 19:38 2021 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 62) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Not respecting yellow flags in turns 8/9/10.
offence: Breach of Appendix H Article 2.5.5. b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll), team representative and reviewed video and telemetry evidence. Although the marshalling system was not showing yellows, the marshals were showing yellow flags from the entry to Turn 8 to the exit of Turn 10. There was one flag point that was not easily visible to the drivers that was showing a double yellow, however this was parallel to an easily visible flag point that was showing a single yellow. The Stewards were able to determine that the driver slowed as required in the regulation, however could have done so earlier. The Stewards therefore issue a warning.
stewards: were able to determine that the driver slowed as required in the regulation
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 18 Yellow Flags
